info.title: Smart Industrial Management System API
info.description:
Every response uses one envelope: `{ success, data, message, errors }`.

Sign in with `POST /auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Access tokens last 15 minutes; refresh with the cookie.

AI results are preliminary language-model assessments grounded in database records. They are not validated failure predictions.

post.summary: Score a machine with the trained statistical model. Inputs come from the database
post.description: Roles: admin, manager. Returns { risk: Low|Medium|High, probability, topFactors, warnings, modelVersion, dataSource }. 422 names any missing input; 503 when the model service is off or down (the rest of the API is unaffected). Trained on synthetic data: probabilities are calibrated inside that synthetic world only. High raises one warning alert per machine.
